sentences.text:
Heard Mr. Aditya Prakash Singh Advocate, holding brief of Mr. Sushil Shukla, the learned counsel
for applicant and the learned A.G.A. for State.

3. This application for bail has been filed by applicant Deepak seeking his enlargement on bail in Case Crime No. 362 of 2018, under Sections 302, 304B, 498A I.P.C., with read Section 3/4 D.P. Act,
Police Station Panki, District Kanpur Nagar during the pendency of trial i.e. Session Trial No. 492 of 2018 (State Vs. Deepak).

entities.text: Police Station Panki, District Kanpur Nagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Deepak vs State Of U.P. on 18 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/43798213/
1 4. Learned counsel for applicant contends that present application for bail has been rendered infructuous inasmuch as the applicant has been acquitted by the court below.
He therefore, submits that present application for bail be dismissed as having rendered infructuous.
5. Learned A.G.A. has no objection to the prayer made by the learned counsel for applicant.
6. In view of above, this application for bail is accordingly dismissed as having rendered infructuous.
